beats.say: Jenna Ortega plans to step away from television after Wednesday ends.
The Hollywood Reporter says she stated she will be off TV for a while once the hit Netflix show wraps up.
You first watched her lead Disney Channel's Stuck in the Middle before becoming a global superstar in Wednesday.
She has also conquered the big screen, starring in Scream, X and the 2024 hit Beetlejuice Beetlejuice.
While movies keep calling, your favourite goth icon is ready for a proper rest because...
